status: Source-only native queue proposal. No build, execution, native hook installation, or full Node environment claim.
implemented: Independent charged native queue owner with retained allocator entitlement; owned native-only intrusive tickets.
FIFO including reentrant native enqueue; refed callback count remains until complete drain, before callback-scope exit.
Consumed ticket is destroyed after actual outcome capture and before the required native uncaught-exception operation.
Required native callback scope encloses the entire queue; cleanup only invokes refed callbacks and requires real JS-disallow semantics.
Optional integration drains native work before public queue snapshot, adds native pending/ref liveness, and preserves unchanged public callback bodies when no native queue is installed.
Completed allocation boundary and reentrant winner selection; no guest handler inputs, public setImmediate substitution, or replacement microtask scheduling.
required_genuine_owners: Hooks.begin/CallbackScope.finish must be the actual InternalCallbackScope and cleanup DisallowJavascriptExecutionScope owner; no implementation is substituted.
Hooks.caught must be the actual native uncaught-exception operation. Main Policy.reportUncaught7B14/Manager9931 were read; process-level scope/teardown composition remains separate.

The actual Native FileHandle/AsyncWrap BaseObject shutdown owner must perform its Source cleanup before queue disarm. Late tickets after disarm are destroyed natively, and are not presented as active Node cleanup callbacks.
exclusion: No Engine or Main changes; public Immediate callbacks, timer phase policy, class shape and methods are unchanged outside optional native queue integration. No production caller currently supplies missing Hooks.
